1.name: First conversations
1.description: Say hello, be polite, get unstuck and say goodbye, and know when to use tú or usted.

2.name: Naming and describing things
2.description: Why every noun is masculine or feminine, how el and la follow from that, and how describing words match.

3.name: Saying who people are
3.description: The verb ser, for who someone is, what they do and where they come from, with family and job words.

4.name: Numbers, time and dates
4.description: Count, tell the time, and name the days and months.

5.name: Saying how and where
5.description: The verb estar, for how someone feels and where something is, with words for the home and for position.

6.name: Saying what you have and what there is
6.description: The verb tener and the word hay, with food, pharmacy and market words, and the many things Spanish says with tener.

7.name: Asking, pointing and saying no
7.description: Build questions and negatives, point at things, and keep a conversation moving the way people do in Mexico.

8.name: Regular verbs today
8.description: The pattern nearly every verb follows in the present tense, and talking about work and habits.

9.name: Irregular verbs today
9.description: The common verbs that break the pattern in the present tense, and how to say what you want.

10.name: Getting around
10.description: Ask for directions and use buses, taxis and other transport.

11.name: Eating out
11.description: Order in a restaurant and name what is on the table.

12.name: Shopping and clothes
12.description: Buy things, ask about sizes and prices, and name clothes.

13.name: Me, him, it, and liking things
13.description: The small words for me, him and it, how gustar works, which runs backwards from English, and verbs like llamarse.

14.name: Health and the body
14.description: Name the parts of the body and say what hurts.

15.name: Your daily routine
15.description: Talk through an ordinary day, with the verbs that do something to yourself.

16.name: What is happening right now
16.description: Estar plus the -ndo form, for what is going on at this moment.

17.name: Plans, free time and comparing
17.description: Say what you are going to do, invite someone, and say that one thing is more than another.

18.name: Home and services
18.description: Deal with repairs, deliveries and the people who keep a house running.

19.name: Phone, appointments and money
19.description: Make a call, set an appointment, and handle a bank or a payment.

20.name: What happened: the preterite
20.description: The past tense for something that happened and finished.

21.name: Problems and emergencies
21.description: Ask for help and explain what went wrong.

22.name: How things used to be: the imperfect
22.description: The past tense for what used to happen, and for what things were like.

23.name: What will and would happen
23.description: The future and the conditional, two tenses built the same way.

24.name: What you have done
24.description: The present perfect, made from haber and a participle.

25.name: Telling someone what to do
25.description: Commands, for instructions, requests and warnings.

26.name: Wishes and requests: the subjunctive
26.description: The verb forms used after wanting or asking for something from someone else.
